originalTitle: iFixit’s Apple HomeView teardown reveals a device that will be difficult to repair

content: After finding recent versions of Apple’s iPads and HomePods much easier to disassemble for battery replacements or other repairs, iFixit assumed it would be the same story for Apple’s new HomeView hub that looks like a seven-inch tablet stuck to a smart speaker. The reality was much different and by the time they got the HomeView apart iFixit’s skilled techs had “ripped a connector, snapped a speaker in two, and put more force on the poor logic board than any of us were comfortable with.” The tablet section of the HomeView proved to be the bigger challenge to disassemble as a result of some questionable decisions with Apple’s design. The glue used to secure the display in place “held on harder than on any Apple product we’ve opened recently,” iFixit says. And while Apple’s decision to turn the HomeView’s entire aluminum chassis into a heat sink was clever, the thermal bond between a heat shield and the device’s logic board made separating the two a “remarkably risky operation.” While these design decisions possibly streamlined assembly at a factory, the extensive use of glue makes servicing the HomeView incredibly difficult. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rr7m9nBqDdo] In an accompanying teardown video iFixit also reveals how much smaller the speaker drivers are in the wall-mounted version of the HomeView versus the tabletop option. Although both versions are priced at $299, the wall version costs a little more when you factor in the required mount that’s not included, leaving iFixit feeling that you’re getting less performance while spending more money.

chineseContent: 在发现最新版本的苹果 iPad 和 HomePods 更容易拆卸以更换电池或进行其他维修后，iFixit 认为苹果新的 HomeView 中心也会出现同样的情况，看起来就像一个粘在智能扬声器上的 7 英寸平板电脑。现实情况却大不相同，当 iFixit 熟练的技术人员将 HomeView 拆开时，他们已经“撕开了连接器，将扬声器折断成两半，并对糟糕的逻辑板施加了比我们任何人都能接受的更大的力量。”由于苹果设计的一些有问题的决定，HomeView 的平板电脑部分被证明是拆卸的更大挑战。 iFixit 表示，用于固定显示屏的胶水“比我们最近打开的任何苹果产品都更牢固”。虽然苹果决定将 HomeView 的整个铝制底盘变成散热器的决定很聪明，但隔热罩和设备逻辑板之间的热粘合使得将两者分开是一项“非常危险的操作”。虽然这些设计决策可能简化了工厂的组装，但大量使用胶水使得 HomeView 的维修变得异常困难。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rr7m9nBqDdo] 在随附的拆解视频中，iFixit 还揭示了 HomeView 壁挂式版本与桌面选项相比扬声器驱动器小了多少。尽管两个版本的售价均为 299 美元，但当您考虑到不包含在内的所需安装支架时，壁挂版本的价格要高一些，这让 iFixit 感觉您花更多的钱却获得了较低的性能。
